messages:
elaine: Hey @people-ops — got an out-of-network dental bill for my 4yo. The clinic sent an itemized invoice and a payment receipt. Plan doc says OON covered at 60% but I need to file a claim. Do I submit the digital ID card from the portal or do you need anything else? I uploaded the receipt to the benefits portal but wanted to check best practice before I submit.

benefits-bot: Quick tip: submit via https://benefits.redwood.com > Claims. Required: itemized receipt, provider NPI, date of service, proof of payment, member ID. Processing is typically 7-10 business days after submission.

Marco: Hi Elaine — thanks for flagging. Yes, use the digital ID card (PDF) for member details. For out-of-network dental claims please include the following when you submit:  

```
Member name + DOB
Member ID (from ID card)
Date of service
Provider name + NPI
Itemized receipt (CPT codes/procedures listed)
Proof of payment (credit card/receipt)
Any EOB from the provider (if available)
```

You can submit through the portal (preferred) or email benefits@redwood.com. If emailing PHI, please password-protect the attachment and send the password in a separate message. If you'd like, I can open the claim on your behalf — I would just need written authorization in reply.

elaine: Thanks Marco — Member ID is 987654321, DOB 2019-08-03, date of service 2026-03-12. Provider: Dr. Sara Lee, NPI 1234567890. I uploaded the itemized receipt and payment proof to the portal now. Please go ahead and open the claim if you can.

Marco: Got everything, thanks. I'll submit this now and confirm the claim number back to you by EOD. Expect reimbursement timeline of ~7-10 business days after the insurer accepts the claim. Note: insurer pays the allowed amount for OON services; if provider balance-bills above allowed amount you'll be responsible for the remainder — if that happens we can escalate with the insurer for review. :thumbsup:

elaine: Appreciate it — thank you! :pray:
